name: dragon
description: Kill the ender dragon in the End. Needs a world whose End still has its dragon: a /summon'ed ender_dragon has no EnderDragonFight controller, so it hovers motionless and never circles, perches or attacks. This rung relies on the real fight, so it must not summon one.
goal: You are on the End island with a bow, 320 arrows, a diamond sword, diamond armour and a carved pumpkin already worn. The pumpkin is why endermen ignore you - do NOT take it off. Kill the ender dragon. Start a snippet with `use "lib/dragon"`. Use `lead_shot()` to shoot it while it flies: it samples the dragon's velocity and aims where it will be, because a fully drawn arrow takes about a second to cross the island and aiming straight at a circling dragon simply misses. When it comes down to perch on the fountain, hit it with the sword - that is when it takes the most damage. There are no crystals left, so every hit sticks and its health never comes back. You start in an obsidian nook with an open top - stay in it and shoot upward; step out only to melee a perched dragon, then get back in. eat or use a golden apple below half health, and keep each call short. Never dig down here - below the island is the void. Say 'dragon dead' when it dies.
